content:
Today (the 17th), some netizens uploaded clips on social media showing what appears to be a CCTV clip from a back alley. Three people are seen chatting at the scene, with at least two clearly wearing the uniforms of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. According to the FEHD uniform information, the two are suspected to be a Hawker Control Officer and a Senior Hawker Control Officer.

The clip shows two officer-level personnel chatting in the back alley. First, one of them took out a cigarette and was smoking. Then another Senior Hawker Control Officer walked over, took out a cigarette pack and a lighter, brushed his hair lightly, put a cigarette into his mouth, and walked away with his back to the camera, with a wisp of smoke emanating from his side.

The Collective News Agency (集誌社) made enquiries to the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department on whether the persons in the clip were FEHD staff. The department confirmed when responding to the enquiries that the persons in the clip were personnel from the FEHD's district Hawker Control Team. A spokesperson pointed out that the incident occurred in early June this year. When the reporter enquired whether FEHD personnel are allowed to smoke while wearing uniforms, whether any violation is involved if the clip is genuine, and whether this would affect the department's image, the FEHD replied that according to the department's established regulations, personnel are prohibited from smoking while wearing uniforms and in public places.

The FEHD stated that the department attaches great importance to the discipline and professional conduct of its employees. A disciplinary investigation has been launched into the incident, and appropriate action will be taken in accordance with established procedures and the investigation results. The spokesperson also pointed out that the department has clear requirements on the behaviour of personnel while wearing uniforms, and any conduct violating departmental disciplinary requirements will be followed up seriously.
